newsitem.title: USA: Avon president to retire due to succession dispute.
newsitem.headline: Avon president to retire due to succession dispute.

text.p: Avon Products Inc. President and Chief Operating Officer Edward Robinson will retire Sunday due to a disagreement over management succession at the diversified cosmetics company, Avon announced Tuesday.
Avon said it had no immediate plans to name a successor to Robinson, 57. His duties will be assumed by James Preston, who is chairman and chief executive officer, it said.
Avon said Preston, 64, will remain in the company for at least the next two years.
Avon spokesman Brian Martin said Robinson had disagreed with the board's decision asking Preston to stay on for two Preston will add the title of president to his positions, Martin said.

While there are no immediate candidates to be Aven's next president, Preston noted the company has "a very strong group of senior operating officers, some of whom recently took on added responsibilities" in the company.
Robinson joined Avon in 1989 as chief financial officer. He became president in 1993.
